title: Deal in second-hand goods only if not disqualified
what: Carry on business as a second-hand dealer (including a pawnbroker) only if not disqualified, for example by a conviction for dishonesty.

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 1996 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on business as a second-hand dealer if the person is disqualified under this section from doing so

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. SA does not license second-hand dealers: it disqualifies people with certain convictions (s 6), and a pawnbroker is a second-hand dealer under the Act (s 3). Reach and framework marks follow the NSW requirement for this family; to check.
